transcript: AI: இன்னைக்கு பாவக்காய் பண்றீங்களா? [Are you making bitter gourd today?] Human: ஆமா lunch-க்கு [Yes, for lunch] AI: English-ல இதை எப்படி சொல்லுவீங்க? [How would you say this in English?] Human: பாவக்காய் is bitter. So bitter vegetable-ஆ? [Bitter gourd is bitter. So bitter vegetable?] AI: Almost correct. இதை Bitter Gourd-னு சொல்லணும். [Almost correct. You should call it Bitter Gourd.] Human: Bitter Gourd-ஆ? Oh okay. English கத்துக்க ஆசை தான். ஆனா coaching-னு போனா costly-ஆ இருக்குமே? [Bitter Gourd? Oh okay. I want to learn English. In just 2 weeks, you will start speaking English confidently. Trial is just one rupee.] Human: கேட்கவே நல்லா இருக்கு. இப்பவே install பண்றேன். [Sounds good to hear. I will install it right now.] Voiceover: Click on Install Now and download MySivi app.
on_screen_text: பண்றீங்களா [Are you making?], ஆமா lunch-க்கு [Yes, for lunch], English-ல இதை [In English, this], சொல்லுவீங்க [will you say], So Bitter [So Bitter], Almost correct [Almost correct], Bitter Gourd-னு [Bitter Gourd], Oh okay [Oh okay], English கத்துக்க [To learn English], ஆனா coaching-னு [But coaching], இருக்குமே [will be], MySivi [MySivi], 7x Cheaper [7x Cheaper], பேசி English [Speak English], 2 weeks-லேயே [In 2 weeks], confident-ஆ [confidently], English பேச [To speak English], 3 days of Premium benefits for ₹1 [3 days of Premium benefits for ₹1], கேட்கவே நல்லா [Good to hear], பண்றேன் [I am doing], MySivi English speaking app Install Now [MySivi English speaking app Install Now]
summary: An AI robot corrects a woman's English translation of 'bitter gourd' while she is cooking. The AI then pitches the MySivi app as an affordable, Tamil-based English learning tool with a 3-day trial for ₹1, prompting the user to install the app.
